install -d -m 0700 /etc/nginx/tls; cat > /usr/local/sbin/renew-nginx-certificate <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
CERT_DIR=/etc/nginx/tls
CERT="$CERT_DIR/server.crt"
KEY="$CERT_DIR/server.key"
RENEW_WINDOW=604800
VALID_DAYS=30
FORCE=0
[ "${1:-}" = "--force" ] && FORCE=1
exec 9>/run/renew-nginx-certificate.lock
flock -n 9 || exit 0
if [ "$FORCE" -ne 1 ] && [ -s "$CERT" ] && [ -s "$KEY" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_WINDOW" -noout -in "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    logger -t renew-nginx-certificate "certificate is valid beyond renewal window"
    exit 0
fi
umask 077
TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d "$CERT_DIR/.renew.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
NODE_ADDR=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
NODE_HOST=$(hostname -s)
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days "$VALID_DAYS" \
    -subj "/CN=node1" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:node1,DNS:$NODE_HOST,IP:$NODE_ADDR" \
    -addext "keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment" \
    -addext "extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth" \
    -keyout "$TMP_DIR/server.key" -out "$TMP_DIR/server.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 0600 "$TMP_DIR/server.key"
chmod 0644 "$TMP_DIR/server.crt"
chown root:root "$TMP_DIR/server.key" "$TMP_DIR/server.crt"
mv -f "$TMP_DIR/server.key" "$KEY"
mv -f "$TMP_DIR/server.crt" "$CERT"
restorecon -F "$KEY" "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
if nginx -t >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
    systemctl reload nginx
fi
logger -t renew-nginx-certificate "installed a new certificate valid for $VALID_DAYS days"
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/renew-nginx-certificate
restorecon -F /usr/local/sbin/renew-nginx-certificate /etc/nginx/tls 2>/dev/null || true
/usr/local/sbin/renew-nginx-certificate
openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt -noout -serial -dates -subject -ext subjectAltName

restorecon -F /etc/nginx/tls/server.key /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

EXPIRING_SERIAL=$(openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt -noout -serial)
